rows.definition: The doc-appeal card's defect integer: AI-voice tells, em-dash floods past the line budget, and un-glossed jargon in reader-facing docs.
rows.distinction: One control-pane CARD integer - NOT the control pane that folds all cards, NOT doc_debt (whole-corpus structure/freshness defects), and NOT readme_debt (front-page freshness only).

rows.definition: The readme-freshness card's defect integer: README.md lagging current CLI syntax, broken quickstart snippets, or unverifiable benchmark citations.
rows.distinction: Front-PAGE freshness only - NOT doc_debt's whole-corpus audit and NOT appeal_debt's prose-voice defects.

rows.definition: The docs card's defect integer: dead local links, stale install pins behind VERSION, unresolved placeholders, missing H1 titles, and orphaned docs across the reader-reachable corpus.
rows.distinction: Whole-CORPUS structure and freshness audit - NOT readme_debt (the front page only) and NOT appeal_debt (prose voice and jargon).

rows.definition: The demo-quality card's defect integer: runnable demonstration scripts that fail to execute cleanly, lack stated prerequisites, or produce failed output.
rows.distinction: Baseline DEMO QUALITY (clean runs, no hidden assumptions) - NOT robustness_debt (surviving boundary inputs and odd environments), NOT seo_debt (published-page front-matter/crawlability/JSON-LD), and NOT the control pane fold.

rows.definition: The demo-robustness card's defect integer: sample apps that fail under malformed user input, abnormal flags, or missing environment variables.
rows.distinction: Hostile-input RESILIENCE of demos - NOT demo_debt's baseline clean-run quality and NOT stability_debt (repo-wide regression vectors and rollbacks).

rows.definition: The industry-parity card's defect integer: LLM-serving feature gaps against production engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp).
rows.distinction: External FEATURE PARITY vs SOTA runtimes - NOT persona_fit_debt (whether named developer/enterprise personas are served) and NOT agent-readiness adoption lenses.

rows.definition: The stability card's defect integer: untracked regression vectors, tail-wagging dependencies, and rollback procedures without a verified exit.
rows.distinction: Repo-wide REGRESSION and rollback hygiene - NOT robustness_debt (demo resilience under bad input) and NOT the control pane's pinned ratchet.

rows.definition: The intent-literal card's defect integer: divergences between the human-stated intent in a test name and the literal assertion it evaluates.
rows.distinction: TEST-NAME-vs-ASSERTION honesty - NOT claim_repro_debt (unfalsifiable CLAIMS.md witness claims) and NOT doc_debt (reader-facing docs).

rows.definition: The claim-repro card's defect integer: unfalsifiable witness claims in CLAIMS.md that no reproducible command or receipt can settle.
rows.distinction: CLAIM falsifiability - NOT intent_literal_debt (test-name drift) and NOT disambiguation-debt (concept-naming clarity, a different honesty axis).

rows.definition: The observability card's defect integer: metrics referenced by dashboards or alerts that the binary does not actively export.
rows.distinction: EXPORTED-METRIC completeness - NOT repo-hygiene tree-cleanliness debt and NOT the control pane's own fold integer.

rows.definition: The RSI-maturity card's defect integer: self-improvement loops that do not close on real telemetry.
rows.distinction: Self-improvement loop CLOSURE on telemetry - NOT guard_rsi_debt (structured explanations for kernel guard decisions, a separate card) and NOT total_debt's raw portfolio sum.

rows.definition: The tooling-quality card's defect integer: maintenance-script defects - missing type annotations, unhandled subprocess errors, and unquarantined external dependencies.
rows.distinction: PYTHON TOOLING quality - NOT code_debt (the Go module's quality surface) and NOT the control pane fold.

rows.definition: The bench-DX card's defect integer: concrete defects that make fak's benchmarks harder to discover, cold-start, learn, read, or compare.
rows.distinction: Benchmark DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE - NOT process_debt (CUDA build reproducibility and isolation) and NOT stability_debt (regression vectors).

rows.definition: The CUDA-development card's defect integer: CUDA build reproducibility failures, environment-isolation leaks, and unsafe host fallback behavior.
rows.distinction: CUDA BUILD PROCESS safety - NOT bench_dx_debt (benchmark usability), NOT py_debt (Python tooling quality), and NOT qa_process_debt (test-process gaps like reverted landings without a regression test).

rows.definition: The persona-fit card's defect integer: matrix-integrity and grounding gaps for the named developer and enterprise user workflows.
rows.distinction: Per-PERSONA service check - NOT parity_debt (feature gaps vs SOTA engines) and NOT the popularization-readiness scorecard's visitor-conversion funnel.

rows.definition: The scorecardpane check that verifies docs/scoreboard-debt.md is fresh against the current control-pane fold.
rows.distinction: READ-side freshness CHECK - NOT WriteScoreboardDebtDoc (which regenerates the doc) and NOT the scoreboard debt page content itself.

rows.definition: The scorecardpane writer that regenerates docs/scoreboard-debt.md so CheckScoreboardDebtDoc reads it fresh again.
rows.distinction: WRITE-side regeneration - NOT CheckScoreboardDebtDoc (the read-only freshness check) and NOT the control pane fold it renders.

rows.definition: The pre-change debt count paired with DebtAfter on doc-freshness RSI verdicts and session-reset card deltas.
rows.distinction: The BEFORE half of one before/after pair - NOT DebtAfter (the post-change count) and NOT total_debt (the portfolio sum across cards).

rows.definition: The post-change debt count paired with DebtBefore on doc-freshness RSI verdicts and session-reset card deltas.
rows.distinction: The AFTER half of one before/after pair - NOT DebtBefore (the pre-change count) and NOT grade_debt (severity-weighted grades).

rows.definition: The debtlane detector dimension 'coverage_debt': unknown, unsupported, or unreadable content inside a lane's source.
rows.distinction: A DEBT-LANE detector dimension - NOT the control pane's per-card debt integers and NOT DimStubDebt (TODO/FIXME/unimplemented panics).

rows.definition: The debtlane detector dimension 'stub_debt': TODO/FIXME markers and unimplemented panics left in a lane's source.
rows.distinction: A DEBT-LANE detector dimension - NOT DimCoverageDebt (unknown/unsupported/unreadable content) and NOT the control pane's per-card debt keys.

rows.definition: Wave 2 of the debt-lane maturity campaign: the flow-ticket set (debtwave2-internal-*, debtwave2-pkg-*) advancing packages toward their maturity targets.
rows.distinction: The SECOND wave label of the debt-lane campaign - NOT debtwave3 (the later wave) and NOT any single debt-lane ticket it contains.

rows.definition: Wave 3 of the debt-lane maturity campaign: the flow-ticket set (debtwave3-internal-*, debtwave3-pkg-*, debtwave3-cmd-*) advancing packages toward their maturity targets.
rows.distinction: The THIRD wave label of the debt-lane campaign - NOT debtwave2 (the earlier wave) and NOT any single debt-lane ticket it contains.

rows.definition: The Python scorecard that grades fak's front door as an ordered conversion funnel (land, orient, trust, install, act) against real-tree affordances.
rows.distinction: The POPULARIZATION lens (does a first-time visitor convert?) - NOT persona_fit_debt's per-persona readiness and NOT agent_readiness's agent-adoption lens.

rows.definition: The structural admission gate (#2911) that scores agent-authored SKILL.md candidates on verbatim dumps, vacuous bodies, marketing voice, session narration, missing verification, and duplicate bodies.
rows.distinction: A SKILL-authoring structural gate - NOT a code test-coverage gate and NOT the rsiloop skill-quarantine gate that reuses its flagged vocabulary.
